'''Blarnak''' was a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] who worked in the bar found within [[Nem'ro's Palace]] in the industrial [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Jiguuna]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Blarnak appeared as a [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] before Game Update 1.2 but was changed to a Gamorrean later.
